label: 話を聞いている女の子
prompt: Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve character asset. Reference image is a visual reference for character identity, costume, pose and painterly style, NOT a background to reproduce. Create ONE isolated character cutout asset on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background (RGBA alpha); no colored paper, no white rectangle, no checkerboard printed into pixels, no scenery, no speech balloon, no calendar, no text, no frame, no ground shadow. Match the attached Japanese children's book illustration closely: warm watercolor/gouache texture, fine soft dark-brown outlines, gentle natural proportions, expressive brown eyes, delicate shading, not glossy 3D and not anime redesign. Keep one consistent character identity. Girl: chestnut bob hair, yellow star hairclip, coral cardigan with small buttons, cream shirt, teal pleated skirt. Boy: tousled short brown hair, blue zip-front hoodie over cream shirt. Final square 1536x1536 composition, character large with a small clear transparent margin around the entire subject. Never crop head, hair, fingers or required objects. Recreate ONLY the listening girl at the LOWER foreground, not the girl riding the pony. Waist-up attentive listener facing SCREEN LEFT toward a speaker that will be placed separately. Gently tilted/lifted head, brown eyes looking LEFT at speaker, CLOSED mouth with slight warm smile; calm listening posture, hands relaxed down rather than a presenting gesture. Chestnut bob, yellow star hairclip, coral cardigan, cream shirt and upper teal skirt. Entire head/hair and upper body visible, intentional waist/hip crop only along lower edge. Exactly one girl alone. No pony, boy, speaking mouth, speech balloon, scenery.
